headline: Vicariously hike the Appalachian in the gorgeous A Trail Tale
summary: Experience the Appalachian Trail virtually in the new game "A Trail Tale." This gorgeous pixel-art title lets you trek without leaving home. Perfect for adventurers and those nostalgic for the great outdoors.

headline: Alt-right troll Milo Yiannopoulos has been deported
summary: Alt-right figure Milo Yiannopoulos has been deported to the UK. He was arrested by ICE for overstaying his US visa. The Department of Homeland Security confirmed his removal.

headline: Sony Music and Warner Chappell are suing Anthropic
summary: Sony Music and Warner Chappell have filed a lawsuit against AI company Anthropic. They allege copyright infringement involving "tens of thousands" of works. Damages sought could reach $150,000 per work.

headline: Distraction-free writing gadget BYOK is adding custom extensions
summary: The BYOK distraction-free writing gadget is introducing custom extensions. This minimalist device caters to serious writers seeking pure text focus. Extensions aim to enhance its core functionality without added clutter.

headline: GTA 6 Will Have No Microtransactions or Generative AI at Launch, Rockstar Says
summary: Rockstar Games confirms Grand Theft Auto 6 will launch without microtransactions. The highly anticipated title will also not feature generative AI at release. This announcement addresses concerns over in-game monetization and AI use.

summary: Discover today's top deals across gaming and entertainment. Find discounts on titles like Tomodachi Life: Living the Dream. Explore offers on the Jurassic Park 4K Collection and updates on Nintendo Switch 2.

headline: EA Motive's Iron Man Game Reveal 'Didn't Go as Planned,' But the Leak Has Marvel Fans More Excited Than Ever
summary: EA Motive's Iron Man game reveal suffered an unexpected leak. Despite the setback, the leak has reportedly boosted Marvel fans' excitement. The incident generated buzz for the upcoming superhero title.

headline: Everything Coming to Apple TV in September
summary: Get a full rundown of all new content arriving on Apple TV in September. Discover upcoming movies, series, and exclusive releases. Plan your streaming schedule with this comprehensive guide.

headline: At least 37 dead and hundreds evacuated after strike on Kyiv weapons depot
summary: A strike on a Kyiv weapons depot has resulted in at least 37 fatalities. Hundreds of residents in the vicinity were evacuated. An investigation has been launched into the storage of military weapons near a residential area.

headline: Cleverly quits shadow cabinet to run for London mayor
summary: Cleverly has resigned from the shadow cabinet. He announced his intention to run for London mayor. The next mayoral election for the capital is scheduled for 2028.

headline: Norway's new king remembers 'my dear father' in first speech
summary: Haakon VIII delivered his inaugural speech as Norway's new king. He paid an emotional tribute to his late father, Harald V. The monarch outlined his vision for his reign.

headline: Sarah Ferguson expected back in the UK 'shortly', source says
summary: Sarah Ferguson, the former Duchess of York, is reportedly returning to the UK soon. Sources indicate she is renting a six-bedroom house in the Home Counties. Her imminent return has been confirmed.
